posts.zh:
dsh-power-button 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。固定在窗口右下角的一键启停按钮：通过脱离终端的辅助进程按原始启动命令重启 DeepSeek Harness（仅本机同源可调），附「仅停止」小按钮。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a417a1425169ff0c9c15.html
posts.en:
dsh-power-button is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. One-click start/stop button pinned to the window bottom-right corner: restarts DeepSeek Harness in place via a detached helper that relaunches the exact boot invocation (loopback same-origin guarded), with an optional stop-only action.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a417a1425169ff0c9c15.html
